.SubPOP-Train is a curated dataset drawn from Pew Research Center's American Trends Panel (ATP), comprising 3,229 multiple-choice questions collected across 53 survey waves (waves 61–132), excluding those already used in OpinionQA. Altogether it contains around 70,000 subpopulation-response distribution pairs. The dataset covers 22 subpopulations defined by demographic, socioeconomic, and ideological traits, and spans over 20 topic areas. Each entry in the dataset is a three-part tuple consisting of a survey question, a target subpopulation description, and the observed human opinion distribution for that group. Questions with more than 10 response options, redacted response data, or dependencies on prior questions were excluded, and GPT-4o was used to make minimal wording refinements to suit language model prompting.
